name: Aries
origin: Aries is associated with the Greek myth of the Golden Fleece and symbolizes new beginnings.

name: Taurus
origin: Taurus is linked to the Greek myth of Zeus transforming into a bull.

name: Gemini
origin: Gemini represents the twins Castor and Pollux from Greek mythology.

name: Cancer
origin: Cancer is connected to the crab sent by Hera in the myth of Hercules.

name: Leo
origin: Leo relates to the Nemean Lion defeated by Hercules.

name: Virgo
origin: Virgo is often associated with Astraea, the goddess of innocence and purity.

name: Libra
origin: Libra symbolizes balance and justice, often associated with Themis.

name: Scorpio
origin: Scorpio is linked to the scorpion that stung Orion in Greek mythology.

name: Sagittarius
origin: Sagittarius is associated with the centaur archer, often Chiron.

name: Capricorn
origin: Capricorn is tied to the goat-fish, often associated with the god Pan.

name: Aquarius
origin: Aquarius is connected to Ganymede, the cupbearer to the gods.

name: Pisces
origin: Pisces is associated with Aphrodite and Eros transforming into fish to escape Typhon.
